Height from the leasing deck's mark, 1,102 ft 6 in above the street. Indoor deck inside the tower outline. The sky deck's shape is scaled from the deck's building section and KPF's description (see data/buildings/hudson-yards.json).

27.6 ft below street level. The 34 St and 35 St halls are at the same depth but do not connect. Hall perimeter, opening sizes and guard positions are scenario reconstructions; shaft landing coordinates are source-rebuilt, not surveyed. The outline is the MTA's, with a margin: it is not the walls.
109 ft below street level. Both entrances lead to it. The outline is the MTA's, with a margin: it is not the walls.
125 ft below street level. One island platform, two tracks. The outline is the MTA's, with a margin: it is not the walls.

A triangle anchored to the east and south sides (KPF). Its tip is scaled from the building section in the leasing deck and reaches 80 ft south; about 7,700 sq ft outside the tower, against KPF's 7,500.
KPF: bleacher steps connect Edge with the 101st floor. KPF's photos show them at the north end of the deck, rising through an opening in the east face. Their size is estimated.
A triangle of 225 sq ft (Wikipedia). Its place toward the tip is read from KPF's photo.
OSM entrance centre line with assumed 14 m width. Joins the unified curved landing hall; former mitred side arms removed.

OSM centre line and existing source-rebuilt escalator endpoints retained. Rounded bend and tapered approach end perpendicular to the long escalators. 14 m hall width and 8.6 m terminal width are scenario dimensions, not a measured wall plan.

Runs the full length of the platform, above it, under one vault. Measured on Dattner's scaled section: 18.4 m wide inside the walls and 7.7 m to the crown, with 5 m wide decks either side of the openings over the platform.
585 ft by 35 ft (178 by 10.7 m) from a secondary source; Dattner's scaled section also measures 35 ft wide. Its axis is the OSM track centre line. It is centred on the official stop position.
